title: Tags vergeben
description: As a developer, I want to label prompts with free tags, so that I can find them later.

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer assigns the tags Support, deutsch and support
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and stores the two distinct normalised tags Support and deutsch
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-011-tags.feature: Tags are normalised and stored once per organisation

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer assigns eleven tags to one prompt
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 422 and names the limit
and: the prompt keeps its previous tag set
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-011-tags.feature: Too many tags are rejected

acceptance_criteria.given: the organisation already uses the maximum number of distinct tags
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer assigns a completely new tag
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 422 and the tag limit is reported
and: an already existing tag can still be assigned
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-011-tags.feature: The organisation tag limit is enforced
